name: Open Landmarks
description: Openly licensed 3D landmark models from Open Landmarks, drawn in the 3D view in place of the buildings they represent. Only models whose rights review has passed are shown.

open-landmarks.purpose: Show 3D models of landmarks in the 3D view.
open-landmarks.dataSent: Nothing about you. The OpenMapX server requests public catalogue and model files.
open-landmarks.dataReceived: Landmark positions, metadata, licences and 3D model files.

openstreetmap.purpose: Place each landmark model on the map and identify the buildings it replaces.
openstreetmap.dataSent: Nothing about you. The placements come with the landmark catalogue.
openstreetmap.dataReceived: Positions, outlines and OpenStreetMap identifiers of the buildings each model replaces.
